highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Skia m152 with Graphite bindings, Vulkan.Silk.NET, and several native lifetime fixes.
highlights_body: This preview line adds backend-neutral async pixel reads, restores Nano Server font support, improves package debugging assets, and trims hot-path allocations.

bullets.detail: Brings the bundled engine onto the m152 upstream line, carries forward the late chrome/m151 fixes, and picks up the subsequent m152 servicing and use-after-free follow-up syncs.
Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU stack across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn so early adopters can start integrating the new renderer.

bullets.lead: New GPU interop APIs and packages
bullets.detail: Adds backend-neutral async `RequestReadPixels` APIs on `SKImage` and `SKSurface`, and ships the `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package for Silk.NET-based Vulkan hosts.

bullets.lead: Native lifetime bugs and leaks fixed
bullets.detail: Fixes rooted-lifetime bugs that could trigger use-after-free crashes in `SKRegion.SpanIterator` and `SKPixmap` derived views, and closes leaks in HarfBuzz blob conversion, raster-image failure paths, and `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset()`.
Windows Nano Server packages switch to FreeType for font discovery again, restoring text rendering in constrained server environments.
Removes repeated allocations and reflection overhead from HarfBuzz shaping, tag formatting, `SKData.SaveTo`, text encoding, and runtime-effect uniform lookups so high-frequency calls do less work.
NuGet package READMEs are refreshed, Apple packages now emit dSYM symbol bundles, and Android symbol packages get deterministic identities for more predictable native debugging.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Restored Nano Server font support by switching the package set over to FreeType.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Simplified Windows native builds by initializing the MSVC environment once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 refreshed the bundled m152 engine, restored Vulkan.Silk.NET package production, improved symbol packaging, and fixed more resource leaks ahead of stable release.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m152 line with Graphite bindings, the Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel reads, Nano Server font support, and several native lifetime fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200 reduces per-call shaping overhead in `Font.Shape` and ships with refreshed package metadata and symbol artifacts for easier package consumption and debugging.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Preview 1 opens the m152 line with Graphite bindings and new Vulkan.Silk.NET support.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.body: It also adds backend-neutral async pixel reads, restores Nano Server font support, and fixes several native lifetime bugs.

v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 Release Candidate 1 refreshes the m152 engine and rounds out the packaging story.
v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14.body: It restores the Vulkan.Silk.NET package build, adds Apple symbol packages, and lands more lifetime fixes ahead of stable release.
